_readme: THE MUSIC STYLE BANK (SONG-CHAIN.md, 2026-09-23). A sung brief names its sound by ONE row id here (`song.style_id`) and nothing else — no free-text style in a brief, ever. machine/song.py builds every chunk's styles from the row, mechanically: positive_styles + "<bpm> BPM" + the row's line for that section name; negative_styles as written.

status: `approved` rows are the only ones a run uses (rule 6: draft / approved / deprecated; `ruled` until 2026-10-07, the team's triage page 15). `draft` rows are written but not yet heard and approved by the owner — song.py refuses them by name until they are. A section name the row has no line for is refused: add the line here, never in the brief.
vocal: the one word the brief's `song.vocal` must match (female · male · duet). bpm: the default tempo; the brief's `song.bpm` may override it with a number.
